description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a study investigating generalization from atomic skills to complex reasoning tasks. The chart contains four slices, representing the categories “Atomic Skill Fail”, “Correct”, “Reason Error”, and “Question Misunderstood”. The slice labeled “Atomic Skill Fail” is dark blue and occupies approximately 68.0% of the chart. “Correct” is a light blue slice representing 12.0% of the chart. “Reason Error” is gray and accounts for 8.0% of the chart, while “Question Misunderstood” is a darker gray and represents 14.0% of the chart. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is provided, associating each color with its corresponding error type. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest proportion and decreasing in size.
